<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

The ROCm 10.1 SDK ships `triton 3.8.0+git669b31ac.rocm10.1.0` (ROCm/triton `669b31ac`, `release/internal/3.8.x`). 
On gfx1250, with `TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING` at its default (`is_expert_scheduling_enabled()` returns true for gfx1250):
- kills gpt-oss-120b-w-mxfp4-a-fp8 under load -- single requests answer, then a memory
  access fault in `_moe_gemm_a8w4_decode` 4 requests into a 600-request run

None of this is there with the Triton the rocm10 image builds (triton-lang/triton `76940ad3`, from main)
But `76940ad3` is past triton-lang/triton#10833 (`9debefe44`, merged 2026-07-15), which removed block pointers, and sglang's FLA kernels still call `tl.make_block_ptr`. So this builds `76940ad3` and reverts `9debefe44` on top.

## Modifications

 - build triton : 76940ad3
 - revert triton commit : 9debefe44

## Accuracy Tests
**gpt-oss-120b-w-mxfp4-a-fp8 TP1**
gpt-oss-120b-w-mxfp4-a-fp8 on `v0.5.22-rocm101-mi45x-20261020-test` (built from this
patch, `triton 3.8.0+gitc9230de6`), gfx1250, TP 1. No `TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=0`.

```bash
ENABLE_CK=0 python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path amd/gpt-oss-120b-w-mxfp4-a-fp8 \
  --tp 1 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --max-running-requests 512 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
  --attention-backend aiter \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --page-size 64 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 3072 \
  --max-prefill-tokens 3072 \
  --port 8000

pip install sgl-eval
sgl-eval run gsm8k \
  --base-url "http://localhost:8000/v1" \
  --model amd/gpt-oss-120b-w-mxfp4-a-fp8 \
  --num-threads 64 \
  --temperature 1.0 \
  --top-p 1.0 \
  --seed 42 \
  --max-tokens 8192
```

| metric | value |
| --- | ---: |
| score | **95.83%** |
| stop_rate | 100.00% |
| truncated_rate | 0.00% |
| error_rate | 0.00% |
| examples | 1319 (single-shot) |
| duration | 204.3 s |
| throughput | 1270 tok/s |
| avg_input_tokens | 147.5 |
| avg_output_tokens | 196.7 |


**DeepSeek-V4-Flash gsm8k** 

| TP | gsm8k | latency | output throughput |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.943 | 287 s | 2435 tok/s |
| 4 | 0.944 | 261 s | 2686 tok/s |
| 8 | 0.941 | 262 s | 2692 tok/s |

Server (`TP` = 2 / 4 / 8; TP4 and TP8 also set `SGLANG_USE_ROCM700A=0`):
```bash
unset NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS
NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1 HSA_HOTSWAP_DISABLE=1 \
SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1 SGLANG_DSV4_REASONING_EFFORT=max \
SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND=unified_kv_triton AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0 AITER_FORCE_A8W4=1 \
SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_MHC_POST_PRE=0 ENABLE_CK=0 SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 \
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash --trust-remote-code --tp $TP \
  --attention-backend dsv4 --page-size 256 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.15 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 2048 --max-prefill-tokens 2048 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 256 \
  --max-running-requests 256 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --port 30000 --disable-custom-all-reduce
```

gsm8k (1314 examples, 5-shot):
```bash
python3 -m sglang.test.run_eval --eval-name gsm8k --port 30000 \
  --num-examples 2000 --num-threads 2000 --num-shots 5
```

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

detail.title: [Fix] [AMD] docker: Build Triton from source for ROCm 10.1 gfx1250

files.patch:
@@ -356,7 +356,12 @@ ENV BUILD_VLLM="0"
 # Keep the Triton that comes with the SDK. The rocm1000 flavor builds a newer
 # Triton from source, and that one no longer has block pointers or
 # triton_kernels (triton-lang/triton#10833), which sglang still uses.
-ENV BUILD_TRITON="0"
+ENV BUILD_TRITON="1"
+ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="76940ad348795521b3dc9f6c79acd7309ff924e3"
+# triton-lang/triton#10833 removed block pointers, which sglang's FLA kernels
+# (fla/, used by Qwen3-Next, MiniMax and Kimi Linear) still call. The revert is
+# pure Python: #9668 had already moved block pointers out of C++/MLIR.
+ENV TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS_DEFAULT="9debefe44117a44c274b05033cfe9e4858883b86"
 ENV BUILD_LLVM="0"
 ENV BUILD_AITER_ALL="1"
 ENV BUILD_MOONCAKE="1"
@@ -399,6 +404,8 @@ ARG SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=""
 
 ARG TRITON_REPO="https://github.com/triton-lang/triton.git"
 ENV TRITON_COMMIT="${TRITON_COMMIT:-${TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT}}"
+ARG TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS=""
+ENV TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS="${TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS:-${TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS_DEFAULT}}"
 
 # ROCm 7.2 Triton (BUILD_TRITON=1 stages only). Both wheels are the same
 # upstream revision, triton-lang/triton@89002410. AITER only requires
@@ -1168,13 +1175,21 @@ RUN cd /tmp/whl \
 # torch 2.11 names this `triton-rocm`; uninstall it so the pin is the only Triton.
 RUN if [ "$BUILD_TRITON" = "1" ]; then \
         case "${GPU_ARCH}" in \
-          gfx1250-rocm1000) \
+          gfx1250-rocm1000|gfx1250-rocm1010) \
             echo "[Triton] gfx1250: building ${TRITON_COMMIT} from source"; \
             pip uninstall -y triton triton-rocm || true \
             && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
             && git clone ${TRITON_REPO} triton-custom \
             && cd triton-custom \
             && git checkout ${TRITON_COMMIT} \
+            && for rev in ${TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS}; do \
+                 echo "[Triton] reverting $rev"; \
+                 git -c user.email=build@sglang -c user.name=sglang-build \
+                     revert --no-commit "$rev" \
+                 || git checkout --ours -- Makefile; \
+                 git -c user.email=build@sglang -c user.name=sglang-build \
+                     commit -q -am "Revert $rev" || exit 1; \
+               done \
             && pip install -r python/requirements.txt \
             && pip install -e . \
             && if [ -d python/triton_kernels ]; then pip install -e python/triton_kernels --no-deps; fi; \
@@ -1190,7 +1205,7 @@ RUN if [ "$BUILD_TRITON" = "1" ]; then \
     fi
 
 # torch 2.11 still Requires-Dist: triton-rocm after the swap above.
-RUN case "${GPU_ARCH}" in *-rocm724) python3 -c "import pathlib,re,importlib.metadata as m; p=pathlib.Path(m.distribution('torch')._path)/'METADATA'; v=m.version('triton'); t,n=re.subn(r'^Requires-Dist: (?:triton|triton-rocm)==[^ ;]+', 'Requires-Dist: triton=='+v, p.read_text(), count=1, flags=re.M); assert n==1, n; p.write_text(t)" ;; esac
+RUN case "${GPU_ARCH}" in *-rocm724|gfx1250-rocm1010) python3 -c "import pathlib,re,importlib.metadata as m; p=pathlib.Path(m.distribution('torch')._path)/'METADATA'; v=m.version('triton'); t,n=re.subn(r'^Requires-Dist: (?:triton|triton-rocm)==[^\s;]+', 'Requires-Dist: triton=='+v, p.read_text(), count=1, flags=re.M); assert n==1, n; p.write_text(t)" ;; esac
 
 # -----------------------
 # Performance environment variable.
